title: Ketan murder case details emerge with conflicting claims
summary: Reports on the Ketan Agarwal murder case describe a conspiracy involving Siya, while family members and police have gathered evidence. Different outlets highlight varying aspects of the investigation into her alleged role.
summary_points: Amar Ujala reports that the mother is demanding death penalty for those responsible.
The father claims Siya concealed the truth about his son's death.
title_hi: केतन हत्या केस में विरोधाभासी दावे सामने आए
